description: This file contains the implementation of the Step2 class for the OpenCart installation process, including methods to display installation prerequisites and save configuration checks.

classes.name: Step2
classes.description: Controller handling the second step of the OpenCart installation process, checking server environment and configuration file status.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the installation prerequisites page, gathering server environment details and configuration file statuses.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates server environment and configuration prerequisites, and redirects to the next installation step if all checks pass.
